title: parse_app_uuids near-duplicates the existing private with_three_uuids helper
detail: Both parse the same three path UUIDs with the same triple-case; the diff's own doc says it mirrors with_three_uuids. The existing helper is private (fn, not pub) so cannot be imported, forcing the re-implementation.
recommended_fix: If a fourth caller appears, promote the UUID-triple parse to a shared helper module (e.g. response_helpers or a new uuid_parse module) and have both application_detail_handler and trigger consume it. Out of scope for RC2.3.
